Theme

Latin word

honestus

honestus, honesta, honestum

honourable, respectable; of good family; honourable, upright, morally good

In this lexicon

  • honourable

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 154, 157, 159, 405

  • moral

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Amic. 44: ut ab amīcīs honesta petāmus; Cic. Fin. 4.25: nec honestō quicquam honestius (Lewis & Short); Traupman 329

  • vir honestus: gentleman

    classical

Examples

  • haec igitur prīma lēx amīcitiae sanciātur, ut ab amīcīs honesta petāmus, amīcōrum causā honesta faciāmus

    let this, then, be laid down as the first law of friendship: that we ask of friends only what is right, and do only what is right for their sakeCic. Amic. 44

    In the entry for moral

  • breve enim tempus aetātis satis longum est ad bene honestēque vīvendum

    for a short span of life is long enough to live well and honourablyCic. Sen. 70

    In the entry for moral

  • probum patrem esse oportet, quī gnātum suom esse probiōrem quam ipsus fuerit postulat

    a father who demands that his son be better than he was himself ought to be a good manPlaut. Ps. 1.5.23 (Lewis & Short)
